column1: # Common Spanish verbs that the conjugator's rules alone would get wrong, with
# the kind of content/verbs/irregular.yaml entry they need. Written by hand;
# tools/packc/tests/test_reference.py checks it against an external verb table.
# The compiler refuses a lexicon verb that matches a line here but has no entry
# in irregular.yaml (an entry `regular: true` overrides). A line starting with
# "-" is an ending shared by a verb family and matches every verb ending with it
# (-tener: tener, mantener, obtener, detener); only endings whose whole family
# conjugates alike are listed (not -sentar: presentar is regular).
# verb or -ending<TAB>pattern   (e>ie o>ue e>i u>ue i>ie accent irregular)
